title: AWS Reference Architectures
content: 2 min readJul 21, 2024--When deploying applications or services in AWS, it’s essential to consider the AWS-provided reference architectures, which fall under the Well-Architected Framework. These architectures are designed to meet specific regulatory compliance needs, such as HIPAA or PCI DSS, and provide best practices for building secure, efficient, and reliable systems.The Well-Architected FrameworkThe Well-Architected Framework is a set of best practices created by AWS to help architects build secure, high-performing, resilient, and efficient infrastructure for their applications. This framework includes several pillars such as operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization.Reference Architectures for ComplianceAWS provides reference architectures for various regulatory compliance scenarios, including:HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act)PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard)UK Official RegulationsThese reference architectures are design recommendations to help you comply with regulatory requirements. Let’s look at an example of a reference architecture for PCI DSS compliance.Example of a PCI DSS Reference ArchitectureA reference architecture for PCI DSS compliance in AWS might include:One AWS AccountOne Production Virtual Private Cloud (VPC)Two Availability Zones (e.g., EU West 2A and EU West 2B)Private Subnets with proxies connecting to the internetRelational Databases in separate private subnetsS3 Buckets for storageIAM Policies for access controlAWS Config for configuration monitoringCloudWatch Alarms for monitoring and alertsCloudTrail for logging and auditingThis setup ensures that sensitive data is handled securely and meets PCI DSS requirements.Accessing and Using AWS Quick StartsTo find reference architectures, AWS provides a service called Quick Starts. Quick Starts are automated reference deployments for key workloads on the AWS Cloud.Visit AWS Quick Starts: Go to AWS Quick Starts.Browse by Category: Choose from categories like database and storage, machine learning, compliance, networking, DevOps, Microsoft solutions, and more.Select a Quick Start: For instance, you might choose the “Standardized Architecture for PCI DSS on AWS”.Review the Documentation: Each Quick Start provides detailed documentation, including the architecture design, compliance details, and deployment steps.Download the Template: Click on “View template” to download the CloudFormation template.Deploying a Quick Start TemplateTo deploy a Quick Start template in AWS CloudFormation:Open AWS Management Console: Go to the CloudFormation service under Management Tools.Design a Template: In the CloudFormation Designer, open the downloaded template file.Visualize the Architecture: The template designer will display the architecture, showing how the PCI DSS-compliant setup is configured.Launch the Template: You can launch this template to deploy the architecture in your AWS account.ConclusionAWS reference architectures and Quick Starts are powerful tools for learning and implementing best practices in cloud architecture. They help you design compliant and efficient systems, provide visual representations of complex setups, and offer automated deployment through CloudFormation. By leveraging these resources, you can ensure your applications are well-architected and meet regulatory requirements.Day #38: AWS Certified Solutions Architect — Associate (SAA-C03) 😊
